The wooden gunsmith has expanded their wares. All non-special guns can now be purchased with the "sage's shot" and "elemental ammunition" upgrades, and already purchased weapons can have the upgrades added for additional time and money.
Purchasing a weapon with one of the two upgrades adds an additional 75 gold to the cost, and purchasing with two adds a yet further 200 gold (so a fae'd wood palm pistol with both upgrades would cost a total of 350gp: 50 gold base cost, 25 gold for fae'd wood, 75 gold for the first upgrade, and 200 gold for the second upgrade).
Adding upgrades to a previously purchased weapon costs an additional 25 gold more than the normal upgrade cost and takes 8 hours per upgrade.
Ammunition with a specific essence quality can be purchased at the price of 50 gold for 5 shots.
**Sage's shot**
Your weapon has been enhanced and altered to rely on your awareness rather than speed. This firearm now uses Wisdom instead of Dexterity to determine its to hit bonus and damage bonus.
**Elemental Ammunition**
This firearm has been upgraded, and now can make use of the varying properties of essence in its shots. A shot fired from this weapon when loaded with essence now has a different effect based on the essence's type. If an essence has more than one quality, choose one quality when you load the gun. Types and effects are listed below:

**Acidic** shots deal acid damage instead of piercing.
When a **chaotic** shot is fired, roll a d12 (1-Slashing, 2-Bludgeoning, 3-Poison, 4-Acid, 5-Fire, 6-Cold, 7-Radiant, 8-Necrotic, 9-Lightning, 10-Thunder, 11-Force, 12-Psychic). The shot deals magical damage of the rolled damage type. 
**Cold** shots deal cold damage instead of piercing.
When loaded with **dimensional** shots, a gun can hold an additional 3 shots before it must be reloaded. 
**Fiendish** shots deal magical piercing damage instead of normal piercing damage.
**Fiery** shots deal fire damage instead of piercing.
**Forceful** shots deal force damage instead of piercing.
**Inert** shots ignore AC boosts from *shield*, other spells, and other spell-like effects.
**Lightning** shots deal lightning damage instead of piercing.
**Mercurial** shots function normally underwater.
**Necrotic** shots deal necrotic damage instead of piercing.
Once per turn when you hit with a **phantasmal** shot, you may make a perception check as a free action.
**Poisonous** shots deal poison damage instead of piercing.
**Psychic** shots deal psychic damage instead of piercing.
**Radiant** shots deal radiant damage instead of piercing.
Reloading a firearm entirely with **theurgic** shots may be done as a bonus action.
**Thundering** shots deal thunder damage instead of piercing.
A target hit by a **vital** shot restores half as much health when healing until the start of your next turn. 
The range of **void** shots are increased by 10 feet if fired from dim light, and by 20 feet if fired from darkness.
the range of **zephyrous** shots are increased by 15 feet if fired from a height, such as while under the effects of the *fly* spell or on an airship.

Sentinel Stuffy
Wondrous item (requires attunement)

A plush toy that more often than not finds the new owner, before the owner finds it. This doll attunes itself to you upon being picked up. While attuned to it and on your person, you gain a +1 to your AC and all saving throws. The stuffy acts as an Unseen Servant with the following changes, it has an AC of 13, 10 hit points, and a Strength of 10.The Sentinel Stuffy also has minimal sentience with an Intelligence of 4(-3), Wisdom of 10(+0), and a Charisma of 16(+3) It cannot speak, but understands all languages spoken by its owner. If you are separated from the Sentinel Stuffy for over 24hrs you will lose attunement, during this time the Stuffy will do all it can to get back to you.If you were to die due to overwhelming damage or from failing death saves, the Sentinel Stuffy takes your place when dying, becoming inanimate, and ending your attunement.

Odd Heart
Wondrous item (requires attunement)

This item is one that has always been with you, your own heart, and its potential only unlocked by an experimental surgery. If you manage to survive the surgery you will awaken to your heart being encapsulated in a containment chamber of your own choosing and connected by a tubing or a cord to your chest. After the surgery you will find yourself permanently under the effect of Sanctuary(DC15) until you are unattuned. Whenever you roll a hit die you always take maximum healing. Once attuned to the Odd Heart you cannot unattune to it unless you die or undergo a more dangerous reversal surgery.

Symbiotic Nature.
The heart can't be removed from you while you're attuned to it, and you can't voluntarily end your attunement to it. If you're targeted by a spell that ends a curse or enter an anti-magic zone, your attunement to the heart ends, and you immediately fall unconscious and start making death saves.

Phlogiston Pidgin
Wondrous item (requires attunement) 

This prosthetic tongue was made with magi who have had their tongues forcibly removed. Taking a lump of molten phlogiston and molding it carefully, a person could replace their lost tongue. 

The extra dimensional energies inherent in the Phlogiston imbue the attuned with the languages of all the planes. While attuned you can cast Tongues on yourself a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus rounded down and resets on a long rest. You can also cast Speak with Animals, Plants, and Dead at will. 

You also gain proficiency in one of the following abilities: Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion. If you are already proficient in the chosen ability you gain expertise instead. 

Owl Feather Arrows
Ammunition 

Fletched with feathers gifted by the Owl Folk of the Fae Wild, these arrows fly silently through the air avoiding nearly all detection. You can add your Wisdom modifier to your attack bonus when firing these arrows or bolts.

When you fire one of these arrows or bolts from hiding, regardless if it hits, the intended target needs to make a perception check vs. your initial stealth check to detect you. If it misses the target makes the check with disadvantage and normally if it hits. If you are not detected you do not need to use the hide action again.

When a rogue uses these arrows or bolts they get an extra 1d6 of Sneak Attack damage.

Sea Farer's Foil (unique)
common, wondrous
rapier

The blade is mounted on a hilt made of sea stone and carved to look like the body of a swordfish. Rumor has it that the piece of stone used was actually a piece of a Lodestone. 

While wielding this rapier and fighting underwater, you cannot receive disadvantage on attack rolls due to not having a swim speed.

Punisher’s Cloak
wondrous item, varies (requires attunement)

This cloak seems to be made from the wings of some foul beast. Through mystical or medical means the cloak is attached to the skin of whoever attunes to it. The abilities granted by the cloak vary depending on rarity. This cloak has 5 charges that recharge on a long rest. The rare versions of the wings are not as well adapted to the user, but still have sparks of life within them and can sometimes be forced to shield yourself or your allies. As a reaction to you or a friendly creature (within 5ft) being targeted by a melee, ranged, or spell attack or forced to make a Dexterity saving throw, you can spend a number of charges to grant half, three-quarter, or total cover. 1 charge, 3 charges, or 5 charges, respectively. 

The very rare version, additionally, gives you +1 to AC and a flight speed of 50ft.
